S.FORM: alang Sipazi' ga niya mki sku Sincik Keng atu Gpho go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 126 buwan, 377 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 93% kyan ku 349 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 7% kyan ku 28 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 71%, saySiyat 19%, Amis 1%, Bunun 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Sipazi' hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Sipazi' hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Sipazi' hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Sipazi' hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'llaw na Sipazi' hya' ga Kawabata. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ [s|ɕ]ipaziʔ ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]ik keŋ atu ɣpħo ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** [s|ɕ]aj[s|ɕ]ijat ** ami[s|ɕ] * βunun * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na [s|ɕ]ipaziʔ ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na [s|ɕ]ipaziʔ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na [s|ɕ]ipaziʔ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na [s|ɕ]ipaziʔ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔllaw na [s|ɕ]ipaziʔ ħjaʔ ɣa kawaβata reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
